description: A trained probe's direction, projected out of the stream it was trained on, in one document, on GPT-2 (CPU, float32). Twenty one-sentence reviews, half positive and half negative, end "Overall, the movie was"; `harvest.h` reads layer 10's output at that last token, and the fit trains a two-class `linear` probe on it against `label` (its classes sorted: `negative`, then `positive`). `fit.probe.W` is the trained probe's weight, a value laid out `[hidden_size, classes]`: `positive` and `negative` select its two columns (a `select` keeps `classes` at size 1, labelled with the class it kept), each summed over `classes` to drop that axis, and `direction` is the one less the other, `W[:, 1] - W[:, 0]`, the direction along which the probe tells positive from negative. `projected` removes it from layer 10's output at every position (`project_out`), and `null` removes the direction scaled to zero, which leaves every vector as it is, so its numbers are the clean run's to the bit. `ld` is each row's logit for the word that matches its review (`answer`: " good" or " bad") less the one that does not (`other`), and each `margin` its mean over the rows: how far the model's next word follows the review's sentiment. The probe is trained and its direction tested on the same twenty rows.
